brand_dna.category: Minimalist barefoot-style footwear and accessories for people who want natural, unrestricted movement.
brand_dna.core_belief: Feet should be set free, not forced into rigid, restrictive shoes - footwear should support the foot's natural function and help people rediscover the natural power of their feet.
proof_points: Zero drop design for a natural, balanced feel
Wide toe box that follows the natural curve of the foot for full toe splay
Canadian owned, with US and Canadian warehouses
Endorsed by a podiatrist, a strength coach, and a physical therapist on the homepage
brand_dna.positioning: Design-led minimalist footwear that pairs the barefoot philosophy with modern, everyday style - not clinical, not loud.

voice_pillars.name: Movement-First
voice_pillars.desc: Frames shoes as a path to freedom and strength, centering how the body moves rather than the product itself.

voice_pillars.name: Quietly Rebellious
voice_pillars.desc: Positions the brand against conventional footwear and invites customers into a cause, not just a purchase.
voice_pillars.quote: We're more than just a footwear brand-we're a movement

voice_pillars.name: Effortless Everyday
voice_pillars.desc: Speaks to easy, all-day wearability that blends into real life instead of demanding attention.
voice_pillars.quote: Perfect for work, training, and all-day wear.

voice_pillars.name: Warm and Human
voice_pillars.desc: Founder-led and approachable, grounding the brand in real people and a healthy-lifestyle vision.
voice_pillars.quote: founded by Meryl and Mick, two individuals passionate about creating footwear

phrases: allows for full toe splay which is exactly what I need during my training
look great but actually take into account the form and function of the human foot
the natural power of their feet

icp: Health-conscious, active adults - runners, trainers, and everyday walkers - who value foot health and natural movement and want minimalist shoes that look good enough for work and daily life.

personas.name: Barefoot Curious
personas.description: New to minimalist footwear and easing in - moved by the transitional insoles, comfort, and 'a step up' from ordinary shoes framing.

personas.name: Movement Pro
personas.description: Coaches, trainers, and serious exercisers who care about form and function - moved by wide toe box, full toe splay, and training performance.

personas.name: Wellness Everyday Wearer
personas.description: Lifestyle-driven buyer wanting a healthier, more intuitive way of moving all day - moved by effortless style, all-day comfort, and the 'redefine the norm' mission.
